verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents Resolve, an in-product AI agent on its root-cause-analysis page. Resolve takes a production error and produces a tested fix as a pull request, which is an AI-generated suggestion built from the user's error data inside Rollbar. Evidence is limited to brief first-party snippets. missing for 10: detail on broader AI insights (e.g., root-cause explanations, trend or summary insights beyond code fixes), in-depth documentation of how Resolve analyzes data, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Resolve is an AI agent in Rollbar that takes a production error and produces a pull request you can review.
Resolve writes a tested fix and opens the pull request for you to approve.
